rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=5, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-5: ONE knob changed vs iter-4 (img_sr 0.0005->0.02, the image-domain BILATERAL RANGE sigma); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_04.json -> this exactly RESTORES the iter-3 config (img_n_bf=5, img_sr=0.02), the hr-best of the whole run. UNDOING THE iter-4 REGRESSION. Trajectory: iter-1 img_n_bf=1 val 0.6657/hr+0.2763/PSNR 19.47; iter-2 img_n_bf=3 val 0.7465/hr+0.3276/PSNR 20.10; iter-3 img_n_bf=5 val 0.7705/hr+0.3335/PSNR 20.18 (HR-BEST); iter-4 tightened img_sr 0.02->0.0005 -> SSIM ticked up to 0.7709 but hr COLLAPSED 0.3335->0.1998 and PSNR fell 20.18->18.60. Failure mode: tight img_sr is the WRONG lever for demo's substrate. The mayo_campaign_state.md 'tighten img_sr->0.0005 for edge preservation' insight is BREAST-specific (tight=good on dense fibroglandular breast); on demo's sparse ellipse phantoms the tight range sigma OVER-SHARPENS - it forces the 5-deep image cascade to act only across hard intensity jumps and stop smoothing the broad noise floor, so noise/PSNR worsens (20.18->18.60 dB) even though the SSIM structural term inches up. headroom is the campaign's primary structurally-bounded score and it is PSNR/noise-sensitive here, so the over-sharpen is net-negative. The img_sr lever is SUBSTRATE-SPECIFIC and OPPOSITE between breast (tight=good) and demo (loose=good). Reverting img_sr 0.0005->0.02 restores the iter-3 hr-0.3335 regime, where the loose range sigma lets the deep cascade do its proven coarse-to-fine NOISE smoothing (the demo lever that earned hr 0.276->0.328->0.335 via img_n_bf 1->3->5 at img_sr=0.02). Chose the clean SINGLE-numeric-knob revert (img_sr only) over also pushing img_n_bf 5->7 in the same iter, to first cleanly RECOVER hr 0.3335 and re-confirm the loose-img_sr regime before iter-6 pushes the proven depth lever further. Held fixed at the iter-3/iter-4 values: img_n_bf=5, proj_n_bf=1, kernels (proj_k=7/img_k=5), proj sigmas (1.0/2.0/0.02), img spatial sigmas (img_sx=1.5/img_sy=1.5), lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 (-> identical val split, directly comparable to iter-1/2/3/4). Wall: iter-4 ran 264 s; img_sr is an init value, zero added compute, so wall ~unchanged, comfortably under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s guard. Hypothesis: reverting the image-domain range sigma to the looser 0.02 undoes the iter-4 over-sharpen and recovers val_score/hr to ~iter-3 (SSIM ~0.7705, hr ~0.3335, PSNR ~20.18), confirming that on demo's substrate loose img_sr is correct (opposite to breast). If hr does NOT recover to ~0.3335, it would mean the iter-4 regression was NOT purely the img_sr lever (re-examine seed/split determinism) - but per the identical-split protocol it should land back on iter-3.
